answer: A jury of seven signs one verdict; two diverging verdicts on the same submission slash each dissenting juror 50 POA and reset that juror's vesting clock to zero. Any identity-link attempt triggers the same reset, so an operator behind a terrace of keys loses the accrued delta on all of them at once. Cost to run 100 linked identities: 100 slashed bonds plus 100 resets, 5,000 POA of forfeited reward against 900 POA that a clean epoch pays. One shared funder signal fires it.
